jobs.description:
Academy Sports and Outdoors is looking for a Loss Prevention Supervisor in Katy, Texas, to ensure the security of our distribution center. The successful candidate will have a strong background in loss prevention, with a minimum of 3 years of relevant experience and supervisory capabilities.

This position demands exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, as well as the ability to implement effective loss prevention strategies. Join us in fostering a workplace that values hard work and growth.

jobs.title: Warehouse Overnight Security Officer (2nd Shift)
jobs.description:
St. Moritz Security Services, Inc. in Katy, TX is seeking a reliable Security Officer to provide overnight security coverage at a warehouse facility.

The role requires a Texas Level II guard card and prior security experience, with a pay rate of $16.50 per hour for 40 hours per week. The position involves monitoring the facility, conducting patrols, controlling access, responding to incidents, and maintaining accurate security reports.

jobs.title: Warehouse Security Officer | Flexible Shifts & Weekly Pay
jobs.description:
Allied Universal is hiring Security Guards for a Commercial Warehouse in Baytown, TX. The role offers 8-hour shifts with morning, mid-shift, and overnight options; pay is $17.00 per hour with weekly payments

Ideal candidates have at least 1 year in security, strong customer service skills, and the ability to stand/walk for long periods. Background checks and a drug screen are required, with first interviews conducted via live video

jobs.title: Baytown: Warehouse Security Officer | Patrol & Safety
jobs.description:
Allied Universal is seeking dependable Security Guards for immediate hire at our Commercial Warehouse in Baytown, TX. The role involves serving as a security officer, conducting patrols, and delivering customer service to protect clients across industries.

Candidates must be 21+ for armed roles, have a high school diploma or equivalent, pass background checks and drug screening, and be able to work outdoors and stand for long periods. Shifts include morning, mid, and overnight with weekly pay.
